fact: In a pilot season reported on 12 June 2025, the National Employment Agency (TECHGHIL) used Copernicus Sentinel-2 data through the TechghilAgro app and dashboard to monitor 612 hectares for 102 farmers at Rosso (21) and R'kiz (81), with 737 app interactions and 5 training sessions.
title: Empowering agriculture in Mauritania with Sentinel-2: The TechghilAgro success story
